paragraphs: A Land Rover Td5 engine rebuild starts from £1,900, regardless of which model it's fitted to — the price tier is set by the engine, not the badge on the boot. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available. Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Land Rover already has instead — strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most Td5 owners choose.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting — sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call — particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild — a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle — restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the six Td5-equipped models you drive.

faqLeft.q: What is the Land Rover Td5 engine?
faqLeft.a: The Td5 is Land Rover's 2.5-litre inline-five diesel engine, produced from 1998 to 2006. It was the first common-rail diesel engine fitted to Land Rover models.

faqLeft.q: Which Land Rover models use the Td5?
Does the Td5 differ between Land Rover models?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The specific ancillaries and mounting differ by application, even though the base engine code is the same. We match by registration/VIN before confirming any rebuild or replacement.

faqLeft.q: Is a Td5 from one Land Rover model compatible with another?
faqLeft.a: Not automatically. A Td5 from a Defender isn't a drop-in match for a Td5 from a Discovery 2 — ancillaries and mounting differ. We always confirm compatibility by registration/VIN.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Td5 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £1,900, regardless of which model it's fitted to. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on Td5 rebuilds across every model it's fitted to, replacing worn components as standard.

faqLeft.q: Do you work on Td5 injector harness issues?
faqLeft.a: Yes. Injector wiring harness oil wicking is a known issue on the Td5, and we inspect and replace it as part of our standard rebuild scope.

faqRight.q: Can you rebuild a Td5 from a Defender?
faqRight.a: Yes. The Td5 in the Defender is one of the applications we work on regularly.

faqRight.q: Can you rebuild a Td5 from a Discovery 2?
faqRight.a: Yes. The Td5 in the Discovery 2 is one of the applications we work on regularly.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Land Rover Td5 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Land Rover if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Td5 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Td5 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history — a particular concern given how many different Td5 applications exist across the Land Rover range — and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
